completion_decisions: The target package is the six-step iterative CFD-to-MIP information lifecycle plus the paper-native discrete Carleton problem.
Figure 4 and Figure 5 are deterministically digitized because the numeric terrain and wind rose are absent.
The printed quadratic binary objective is converted to MILP with an exact three-inequality product linearization rather than being silently treated as linear.
Pinned HiGHS replaces unavailable Gurobi 5.6; each receipt records status, incumbent, dual bound, and gap.
A Jensen initial row and terrain-aware replacement-row surrogate exercise the information lifecycle but are explicitly not labeled CFD.
The five relaxation cases and 30-second per-MIP budget are retained; finite termination follows from at most 400 newly known locations plus one final no-new-location solve.

hpc_admission.H6: Waffle 7545dcf exposed nonconvergence at the unsupported twelve-iteration ceiling; finite-bound and five-case parallel repair passed local full-lifecycle smoke and awaits immutable Waffle confirmation

missing_information: author 20x20 terrain and numeric twelve-sector wind rose
Gurobi model/source, exact settings, and warm starts
final cell arrays and per-iteration histories

paper.authors: Jim Y.J. Kuo and David A. Romero and J. Christopher Beck and Cristina H. Amon
paper.title: Wind Farm Layout Optimization on Complex Terrains – Integrating a CFD Wake Model with Mixed-Integer Programming

open_solver_source.name: HiGHS
open_solver_source.role: replacement open MILP backend, not paper-linked author source

paper_source_conflicts: The objective displayed as MIP contains binary products and requires an unprinted linearization.
The private terrain/CFD arrays are essential to author numerical values but are not supplied.
The paper reports Gurobi 5.6 under 30 seconds but omits tolerances, hardware-equivalent settings, and model source.

scope.claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of equations, discrete problem, relaxation study, exact MILP linearization, and iterative update lifecycle on a figure/surrogate proxy; not author CFD, Gurobi, or numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: exactly 20 binary cells and pairwise five-diameter conflicts on a 140 m grid

decision_variables.resolution: 400 cell-selection binaries plus one product binary for every nonzero unordered interaction pair

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: row-major 20x20 cell IDs mapped to 140 m cell centers

initialization.resolution: all rows initially approximate; deterministic feasible high-resource warm start is supplied to HiGHS

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: iterations, new and cumulative CFD locations, CFD simulations, final surrogate objective, no-wake upper bound, efficiency, solver status/bounds, and runtime for each relaxation value

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize probability-weighted kinetic-energy base minus additive directed wake-energy losses

paper_native_cases.resolution: 2.8 km square, 20x20 cells, 20 turbines, 12 sectors, and C={1,.7,.4,.2,0}

parameters.resolution: CT=.8, hub=77 m, D=80 m, rated=1.5 MW, roughness=.1 m, printed Eq.5, Jensen initial row, terrain-aware replacement surrogate

stopping_and_physical_fes.authority: target six-step lifecycle and 30-second MIP report
stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: stop when the selected layout contains no new CFD location; each new location represents twelve single-turbine CFD-row simulations; at most 400 locations plus one final convergence solve

update_order.resolution: solve MIP, mark newly selected source cells, replace their twelve-sector rows, then solve the next MIP

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.authority: target Eqs. 1-5 plus declared missing-field surrogates
wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: figure terrain, printed power-law background, relaxed initial rows, terrain-aware replacement rows, and exact binary-product MILP

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: twelve 30-degree sectors; probabilities are normalized digitized radial lengths and preserve dominant west
